messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — I'm piloting a 'curation handoff' for onboarding records missing product_usage + owner. Plan: auto-enrich via 3rd-party (enrich API) + send remaining to manual review queue (cs-curation-review). Looking for quick ops + infra thumbs-up before I flip the 5% sampling flag.

olivia_cs_ops: Love it. What's the sampling logic and guardrails? Can we gate by trial ARR > $500/mo and exclude opt-outs?

kai_data: Suggest deterministic sampling so we can rerun and compare. e.g. murmurhash(account_id)::bigint % 100 < 5. Also add telemetry filter (events_last_7d >= 3) to avoid enriching inactive leads.

devon_eng: From infra: webhook to /csops/enrich can handle ~200 qps but we should batch. What's payload shape? We'll need to add rate-limiter + dead-letter topic if enrich fails.

maria_cs: SQL sketch below — starting with 5% sample and dry-run for 24h. Tagging run_id = curation-20260323. After enrichment, any record still missing owner routes to queue 'cs-curation-review'.

```sql
SELECT account_id
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE product_usage IS NULL
  AND trial_active = true
  AND (murmurhash(account_id)::bigint % 100) < 5
  AND opt_out = false
  AND events_last_7d >= 3;
```

kai_data: Minor tweak: use murmurhash to keep distribution stable. Also add company_timezone != 'NULL' if we want to prioritize local-hours owners. Exclude accounts flagged in legal_hold.

devon_eng: Payload we expect: POST /v1/enrich 
Body: {"account_ids": ["a123", "b456", ...], "run_id":"curation-20260323"} — we'll accept batches up to 200 ids. We'll push failure messages to topic cs.curation.enrich.failed.

olivia_cs_ops: Operational question: who owns the manual review queue? @sam_ops? We need a clear 48h SLA for owner assignment.

sam_ops: I can rotate ownership for the next 2 weeks. SLA 48h is fine. I'll add a triage checklist in Asana and a Slack shortcut to claim items.

playbook-bot: Automations scheduled: curation-run-scheduler will run at 09:00 UTC. dry_run = true. Notification: #csops-monitoring.

maria_cs: Dry-run = true for 24h, then flip to false. I'll export logs and sample outputs to the monitoring channel and attach a small validation CSV.

devon_eng: I'll create a LaunchDarkly flag curation_v2_sample and wire it to the scheduler. @maria_cs ping me when you want the flag on. Also adding a temporary rate-limit rule on the enrich endpoint.

olivia_cs_ops: Can we add a smoke test checklist? I'll run manual checks on 30 accounts post-dry-run (verify owner accuracy, no PII leakage, correct enrich fields).

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll update the playbook wiki with the SQL, API contract, run_id conventions, and rollback steps. Target rollout: Monday 2026-03-23 09:00 UTC if no blockers. :thumbsup:

sam_ops: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the triage rotation and the Asana playbook task.

kai_data: I'll add the SQL to data-platform repo and schedule a metrics job to emit: enriched_count, owner_assigned_count, review_queue_size, enrich_fail_rate.

maria_cs: Thanks team — will post the doc PR in #docs and drop a short summary in #eng-prod. Flipping dry-run after checks.

maria_cs: (later) flipping dry-run -> true -> still true? confirming next step: enable flag for 5% tomorrow after Olivia's smoke tests.
